title: Chronicle original native identity
description: Canonical key: chronicle:v1:<harness>:<URL-safe base64 of UTF-8 session_id, no padding>. Only a record's matching original identity object qualifies its identifier. Bare historical IDs remain legacy even if their text matches the canonical namespace. Ambiguous reserved-prefix legacy records block new attribution/grouping pending an explicit additive mapping; their bytes are never migrated implicitly.
